description: Bindings of Faith Level 60 Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bindings of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal. Requirements: - Desecrated Bindings - Wartorn Cloth Scrap x 6 - Arcane Crystal - Nexus Crystal
name: Bindings of Faith
